def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # convert numeric columns stored as text
    for col in ['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
    # fix label variants
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().replace({'Bisco': 'Biscoe'})
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip().replace({'nan': None})
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip()
    # enforce valid ranges on body_mass_g
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g'])
    totals = d.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in totals.items()}
